name: Greatsword
description: A two-handed greatsword, 1.45 m from pommel to point (the long class of swords, 1.3–1.5 m): a wheel pommel, a long leather grip bound with cord, a broad crossguard with down-turned quillons, a ricasso with parrying lugs and a long double-edged blade. It stands on its pommel as held, grip along +z and edges to ±x.
